terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: FastAPI backend (uvicorn) on http://localhost:8000 -- API, /docs, /health, and the embeddable chat widget at /widget/.
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && (sudo -u postgres pg_isready -q 2>/dev/null || bash .cursor/start.sh) && . .venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg://ai_process_engine:local_development_only@localhost:5432/ai_process_engine' APP_ENV=development AI_PROVIDER=deterministic CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS='http://localhost:8000,http://localhost:5173' && exec uvicorn src.api.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --no-access-log

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite + React staff web app on http://localhost:5173, talking to the backend API.
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/web/app" && exec npm run dev -- --host
